app.name: Libriant
desktop.title: Libriant Desktop
desktop.intro: Install the Libriant desktop app — the same Libriant in its own window, with silent receipt and label printing.
desktop.notPublished: The desktop app isn't available to download yet — check back soon.
desktop.installHint: Open the downloaded installer and follow the prompts. The app keeps itself up to date automatically.
desktop.macFirstOpen: On macOS, the first time you open the app: right-click it (or Control-click) → Open → Open. This is only needed once.
desktop.upgradeTitle: The desktop app is a paid feature
desktop.upgradeBody: The Libriant desktop app is included with paid plans. Upgrade your plan to download and use it.
desktop.gateTitle: Desktop access needs a paid plan
desktop.gateBody: Your current plan doesn't include the Libriant desktop app. Upgrade to keep using it, or open Libriant in a web browser.
states.errorRecovery: Please try again. If the problem keeps happening, copy this code and send it to Libriant support: {code}.
table.noMatchesHint: Nothing matches your search. Try a different word — searches are accent-insensitive.
announcements.ackNote: You'll see this every time you sign in until you acknowledge it.
scan.hint: Point your camera at the barcode.
scan.unsupported: Scanning isn't supported in this browser — type the code in by hand instead.
scan.permission: Libriant needs camera access to scan. Allow it in your browser, or type the code in by hand.
scan.error: Couldn't start the camera. Type the code in by hand instead.
offline.banner: You're offline — showing recently loaded data. Reconnect to refresh.
confirm.typeHint: Match is case-insensitive. The confirm button stays disabled until the text matches.
